title: Congee with Soy-Marinated Eggs & Chicken
description: Savory rice porridge with shredded chicken, ginger and a soy-marinated soft-boiled egg.
steps: Boil the egg 6 minutes, cool, peel, then marinate in the soy sauce and sugar for at least 2 hours.
Simmer the rice in stock for 25 minutes until soupy, season and stir through the chicken, ginger and butter.
Top with spring onion, peanuts and the halved marinated egg.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food congee with soy eggs

notes: A savory, warming alternative to sweet breakfasts — great on a cold morning or if you're not a cereal person.
